title: Slate
about: Blit's Slate windows: a grey title bar with its boxes together on the right, a bevelled frame, Blit's capped dialog buttons and a thin shadow, coloured by the Pewter scheme -- choose Pewter Dark for the dark look. It needs Blit's glyphs (Appearance > Glyphs: Blit); elsewhere the frame, title bar and buttons are drawn as plain lines.
